proposed_facts.reason: StageData identifies the on_start slot; the parameterless void wrapper calls the returning generator constructor and discards its result. Void does not mean non-returning.

Canonical ordering places map-5 lookup and Ground extraction before the category guard. The UFO consumes the transient signal and clears it in the unconditional update tail; no local null guard is present.

Initializer arguments and the animation implementation distinguish joint index 0, type mask 7, animation index 0, frame 0 and rate 0. Baseline initialization and recurring joint/collision output agree with the proposal.
The complete crane switch supports the delayed threshold observations, randomized target calculation, downward-only immediate clamp, strict stopping threshold and directional acceleration reversals.

The UFO switch preserves signed parameter casts, blocked-success retries without timer reset, camera release-before-helper ordering, distinct state-2 flag gate, carried departure timer and unconditional signal clearing.
Callback rows and initialization identify map 3 as the helicopter and map 5 as the UFO. The helicopter checks map 5 before entry and departure; it is not coordinating with another helicopter.

The placement producer proves UFO x1==2 is a placement condition. Helicopter transitions load no stay timer and increment x4 even after departure completion resets it. Animation argument 7 is a type mask.

contradictions.reason: Accepted deferral of the small-BSS width/extent claim: the static typed pointer declaration does not establish compiled section bytes.
Accepted deferral of all three diagnostic-section claims. Diagnostic argument flow is supported, but section placement, byte extent and alignment-only remainder require compiled evidence.
Accepted deferral of all four floating-point section claims. Arithmetic and literal purposes are visible; compiler pooling, section composition and read-only placement are not established.
The non-returning characterization is contradicted by an ordinary void wrapper and returning constructor; proposal index 0 resolves it.
Conditional-only lookup is contradicted by the callback's ordering; proposal index 1 resolves it without hiding the absent null guard.
Animation index 7 is contradicted by argument forwarding and mask tests; proposal index 2 resolves the confusion.
Proposal index 3 correctly replaces the incomplete crane explanation with asymmetric crossing behavior and the strict stopping test.

Proposal index 4 resolves omitted UFO branches and lifetime ordering. Accepted owner-scoped deferral of the colliding rendered animation names: the predicates test different bits and must not be treated as interchangeable.

Proposal indices 5 and 6 resolve both helicopter contradictions: map 5 is the UFO, x1 is placement rather than terminal phase, no heli_stay_time is loaded, and completion still executes the unconditional timer increment.

unresolved: Eight inherited compiled-section claims remain deferred pending appropriate compiled evidence.
The external animation-predicate naming collision remains deferred to the granime owner; canonical predicates remain distinguished.
Historical spellings, collision category 1's broader identity, individual scenery asset identities and valid configuration ranges remain uncertain.

Supported inherited names, facts and all links are retained unchanged. Acceptance covers the seven verified changes and examined contradictions, not a new independent audit of every inherited retained row.

fact_dispositions.reason: Source proves an uninitialized static typed pointer, not compiled small-BSS payload extent or width. No compiled evidence delivered.
Diagnostic argument flow is supported; attribution of the literal to this compiled section is not established.
Neither section bytes nor alignment-only remainder follows from a C string literal. Requires compiled evidence.
Source-file diagnostic purpose is supported but section attribution is unverified.
Inline numeric uses do not prove compiler pooling, read-only placement or loads from this section.
Gameplay arithmetic is supported, but attributing its supply to this compiled section requires compiled evidence.
Source contains the listed literals but cannot establish compiled pool composition or section type.
Literal purposes are visible, but a read-only section literal-pool claim is not proven by source.
Void return means no returned value, not non-returning control flow.
Map-5 lookup and Ground extraction occur before the category guard, not only on a match; preserve absence of a null guard.
Crane setup passes animation index 0 and type mask 7 at frame/rate 0; it does not start animation 7.
Improve numeric timing and preserve asymmetric target crossing: downward clamps, upward does not. State 7 threshold is strict abs(acceleration)>initial speed.
Existing summary omits blocked-success retry behavior, additional state-2 animation flag gate, carried departure timer and release-before-helper ordering.
Map object 5 is the UFO, not a second helicopter controller.

evidence.why: Type mask and distinct flag tests.
